facts.text: HoverAviary is the single-drone hover task: hover at height 1.0 and remain stable
The action is a 4-element normalized RPM command in [-1, 1]
The action space is a Box with low -1 and high 1 for each of the 4 motors
The observation is 12 values: position (3), roll-pitch-yaw (3), linear velocity (3) and angular velocity (3)
The default simulation frequency is 240 Hz and the default control frequency is 48 Hz
The control period is 1/ctrl_freq and the physics step is 1/sim_freq; the environment runs sim_freq/ctrl_freq physics sub-steps per control step
The episode truncates when step_counter / SIM_FREQ reaches the episode length
The episode terminates when the altitude is below 0 or above 3 m, or when the absolute roll or pitch exceeds pi/2
The reward is -(height error) - 0.1*(xy error) - 0.05*|velocity| - 0.05*(|roll| + |pitch|), plus 1 when both errors are below 0.05 and -100 when terminated
The info dict reports the position and the absolute height error
reset(seed, options) delegates the seed to the Gymnasium base class, restores the initial position and orientation, zeroes step_counter and last_clipped_action, and returns the observation and info
step preprocesses the action, runs the physics sub-steps, increments step_counter by SIM_STEPS_PER_CTRL and returns observation, reward, terminated, truncated and info
With the MuJoCo physics mode each simulation sub-step advances the model with mujoco.mj_step
The package's runtime dependencies are gymnasium>=0.29.0, mujoco>=3.0.0 and numpy>=1.21.0; no hardware transport is declared

determinism.notes: reset(seed) records the seed and the hover start pose is fixed, so one action sequence repeats from a reset; the fake is deterministic as well and makes no random draw

gaps: the fake backend is a pure Python kinematic stand-in, not MuJoCo: it integrates placeholder accelerations and angular-rate gains, has no contacts, thrust/torque actuator, ground effect, drag, downwash, wind, obstacles or sensors, and was not compared with the upstream environment
the upstream F1 model has rigid-body MuJoCo contacts and an RPM-to-thrust/torque actuator; it was not run here because the gate neither installs MuJoCo nor imports the clone
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance the lockstep environment only
timestep_ms is the physics step (1/240 s); one cap.world.step.v1 tick is one control step of 5 physics sub-steps (1/48 s, base_aviary.py:350-354, 585)
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
